name: WINNIE-THE-POOH: Honey Distortion
source:
A mystery visual novel with point-and-click mechanics, inspired by A. A. Milne's stories.

Explore the 100 Acre Wood, meet old friends and solve new mysteries.

[From [url=https://ignis-sanat.itch.io/honey-distortion]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款融合点击探索机制的悬疑解谜视觉小说，灵感源自A·A·米尔恩笔下的经典故事。

探索百亩森林，重逢昔日老友，解开崭新的谜团。

[摘自[url=https://ignis-sanat.itch.io/honey-distortion]itch.io[/url]]
